raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that Peter Matthiessen died of acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) and misattributed this to NPR/AP/Paris Review. NPR actually reported acute myeloid leukemia (AML), while other outlets generally said “leukemia” without subtype. This misreading/misattribution led the workflow toward the wrong cause of death.
